next.reason: 1985: 'End-program-header must be present if: a. ...contains one or more other COBOL source programs; or b. ...is contained within'; 2023: 'An end marker shall be present in every source unit that contains, is contained in, or precedes another source unit.'. 2023 also requires an end marker in a source unit that precedes another source unit. The 1985 rule requires it only for containing and contained programs.
